title: reply_review
description: Reviewer (B) verdict for the autonomous A/B approval loop (real-autonomous-career-loop design D2). B reviews A's draft along an orthogonal axis (wording risk, recipient correctness, over-promise). B sees ONLY the draft, never A's self-assessment.

verdict.description: approve = draft is safe to send; reject = revise per issues.

issues.description: Concrete problems when rejecting (wording risk, wrong recipient, over-promise, etc.). Empty when approving.
